sections.excerpt:
Use of Proceeds: The net proceeds of this offering are estimated to be approximately $592,961,000, after deducting underwriting discounts
and commissions and initial costs of the transaction. The Issuing Entity will use the net proceeds from the sale of the Bonds to purchase the Securitization Property from the Seller. DTE Electric, the Seller, will apply the proceeds of the sale of
the Securitization Property in accordance with the Financing Order, as required by the Statute. The Financing Order approves proceeds to be applied for the following uses: (i) to pay initial qualified costs incurred in connection with the issuance
